derivation: perhaps strengthened from the base of G4486 (ῥήγνυμι) (as if jagged by rents);

occurrences.text: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
